Asset type: original 3D exercise demonstration image for the Forma fitness mobile app. Create one polished landscape 3:2 instructional render with EXACTLY TWO equal side-by-side panels, no text or numbers or arrows anywhere. Right panel: bottom of a comfortable squat with hips moving back and down, knees bent roughly to a right angle tracking the toes, heels planted, chest lifted with neutral spine. The same adult gender-neutral anatomically plausible athletic mannequin and identical proportions in both panels. Entire body and both feet fully visible, uncluttered three-quarter SIDE view, same camera and scale. Matte pale-silver skin, smooth neutral featureless face, fitted muted sage green athletic shirt and dark charcoal shorts, barefoot. Do not draw anatomical cutaways or colored muscle overlays. Dark forest-green studio backdrop #10231D, subtle soft floor shadows, sophisticated realistic 3D materials, even lighting with clear limb contours. Each panel spacious enough to inspect the movement, thin subtle gap between panels. A credible exercise education diagram, not a fashion pose or medical claim. Avoid extra limbs, extreme range of motion, rounded back, raised heels, knees collapsing inward, weights, machinery, cropped feet, logos, watermarks, decorative graphics. Render the two distinct phases accurately, not two copies of the same pose.
